title: Sticks = slabs
description: datapack that makes sticks craftable into slabs and vice versa
body:
Simple datapack that makes sticks craftable into slabs and vice versa. Also makes slabs craftable into blocks.

Reason: 
3 planks make 6 slabs
2 planks make 4 sticks

6/3=2
4/2=2

This means a stick is a slab... Somehow
